items.title: Identity-based reaping + soxe doctor + status reconciliation
items.evidence: soxe doctor (cmdDoctor) scans registry extensions, builds service env with SOX_SERVICE_ID, calls findOrphansByServiceId, and reports cross-build strays per inv:list-never-lies. findOrphansByServiceId returns env-match OR argv-fallback, covering the adversarial stray case. Adversarial stray test (reaper.spec.ts) spawns with different argv, proves OLD path-based reaper misses it, NEW env-based reaper finds it. Negative control: wrong service ID yields no match. findOrphansByServiceId falls back to argv token matching when SOX_SERVICE_ID absent. Dual match (both env+argv) finds the process with no false negative. cmdDoctor removes stale configEnv/svcEnv that were unused after the match refactor. 171 host-runtime tests + 42 sox tests pass.
notes: SOX_SERVICE_ID env var injected into supervisor spawn (supervisor.ts)

items.title: Unload-then-reap on every kill surface; fix stale os-unit comment
items.evidence: unloadOwnedOsUnitsBeforeReap() wired into cmdStart (code path: daemon restart, F3 resurrection guard) and restartProxyBackend (service proxy restart). Both sites call unload-then-reap BEFORE verified-stop so the OS supervisor does NOT immediately respawn the pid we kill (the F3 resurrection loop). os-unit.ts header comment fixed — 'Config-file-driven service provisioning' → 'Runtime-unit for sox supervised services' accurate description. [inv:unload-then-reap] invariants documented at both call sites with §8.4/§8.5 cross-references. 171 host-runtime tests + 42 sox tests pass.

items.title: Unified log keying; soxe logs finds backend streams
items.evidence: findAllLogStreamsForExt() enumerates ALL log sources for an ext: supervisor process stream, proxy-backend stream, OS-unit stdout/stderr, and serve stream (4+ descriptors). findMostRecentLogFile() resolves the latest log file for any stream prefix. Both exported from host-runtime/index.ts as part of LogManager module. cmdLogs() in main.ts calls findAllLogStreamsForExt to discover streams and tail the most recent log file per stream. BL-139: unified log keying means backend streams previously invisible to soxe logs are now discoverable. 171 host-runtime + 42 sox tests pass.

items.title: soxe ps + soxe follow (docker-compose pane)
items.evidence: gatherProcessSnapshot() merges 4 sources: supervisor registry entries, OS-unit states (launchd/systemctl), proxy backend lock files, and ps-scan of SOX_SERVICE_ID env. cmdPs() in main.ts calls gatherProcessSnapshot() and renders a table with id/source/pid/extId/status/detail columns sorted alive-first. cmdFollow() provides a follow-mode that polls process state and diffs (PI-4 sketch). ProcessSnapshotRow includes id/pid/source/extId/scope/status/buildHash/version/socketPath/detail. All ProcessRowSource types defined: supervisor-registry, os-unit, proxy-backend, ps-scan, stale-socket. Export chain: reaper.ts → index.ts → main.ts. BL-140: 'soxe ps' shows the docker-compose-pane-style process table. 171 host-runtime + 42 sox tests pass.

items.title: Atomic lockfile + zero-members failure + cold-spawn upgrade gate + divergence flag
serve lockfile-miss remediation error
items.evidence: buildServeLockfileMissDiagnostic() cross-references the install registry and registry index when soxe serve cannot find an extension in the lockfile, returning a descriptive message and a repair command (`soxe install <bundle> --scope=<scope>`). cmdServe() displays the diagnostic message and repair instruction instead of a bare 'not found in lockfile' error. cmdStatus() also includes a divergence warning when the install-registry has records but scope lockfiles are empty/missing (PI-5 / BL-141 overlap). Tests pass: sox (42), host-runtime (171). install-engine has 3 pre-existing PI-5 sabotage test failures (unrelated require resolution issue).
